meta.title: Planera - Pick your time, enjoy the ease
meta.description: Pick a free slot with a barber, doctor, tutor or any other service and book in a few clicks.

common.error: Something went wrong, please try again.

footer.logoAlt: Planera - Pick your time, enjoy the ease.
footer.note: All prices in AZN, all times in Baku time.

home.slogan: Pick your time, enjoy the ease.
home.title: Pick a free slot, book in a few clicks
home.lead: See the real-time availability of barbers, doctors, tutors and consultants. No calls, no messaging.
home.tagline: Appointments, notes, live reminders: in one place.
home.searchPlaceholder: What service are you looking for?

live.title: Live reminders, nothing forgotten
live.reminderText: A notification reaches your phone a day, an hour and 15 minutes before the appointment; in the app the alarm reads it aloud.
live.voiceText: Pick the date and time on the calendar, then say the note: speech becomes text, the time is yours to choose.
live.diaryText: Appointments and personal notes in one list, with editing and deleting.

how.title: How it works
how.findText: Choose a professional by category, city, price and rating.
how.slotText: Only genuinely free slots are shown, with the service duration taken into account.
how.confirmText: Get your booking number; reschedule or cancel from your account.

auth.failed: Something went wrong, please try again.
auth.offline: Could not reach the server. Check your connection.

offline.title: No internet connection
offline.text: Appointments and free slots are only available online. Try again once you are connected.

install.label: Install the app
install.title: Add Planera to your home screen
install.iosSteps: In Safari tap <share>Share</share>, then <add>Add to Home Screen</add>. Reminders only arrive in the installed app.
install.otherText: Your appointments and reminders one tap away, like an app.
